rules: Reading reference material never creates or modifies a verified terrain case.
Reference material may inform hypotheses, inspection questions and bounded lesson design only.
Only YACS evidence that passes the required technical and human acceptance gates may later enter verified case memory.
Reference material cannot grant road admission or production authoring permission.

source.title: Editor Apply Spline | Unreal Engine 5.8 Documentation

principles: EditorApplySpline deforms Landscape using a spline component and can target a named Landscape Edit Layer.
Spline width and side-falloff inputs are expressed in the spline component local space.
Raise Heights and Lower Heights control whether the operation may move terrain toward the spline.
bob_constraints: Do not infer undocumented absolute-Z, transform or layer-composition semantics from this reference.
Measure the actual affected footprint and height delta after every bounded trial.

principles: Landscape splines affect the heightmap through a Spline Edit Layer.
The Landscape can be raised or lowered to fit the spline with a smooth falloff controlled by spline width and falloff settings.
Spline authoring is a specialized terrain-deformation workflow and should remain isolated from the imported Base_DTM.
bob_constraints: Treat the spline edit layer as procedural terrain authoring, not as proof that a generated road is geometrically correct.
Keep Base_DTM immutable during builder lessons.

source.title: Landscape Edit Layers in Unreal Engine

principles: Landscape Edit Layers separate heightmap and weightmap changes into independent non-destructive layers.
Spline Edit Layers are specialized procedural layers managed separately from ordinary sculpting layers.
bob_constraints: BOB may author road earthworks only in the designated Road_Earthworks ownership boundary.
A layer type match does not replace before/after proof of the actual terrain contribution.

source.title: Low-Volume Roads Engineering Best Management Practices Field Guide

principles: Mountain-road earthworks should distinguish cut, fill, benching, slope stabilization and retaining solutions instead of forcing one heightfield recipe everywhere.
Balanced cut-and-fill can reduce earthwork in suitable terrain, while steep ground may require different construction strategies.
Drainage and slope stability are part of the road-earthworks problem, not decorative afterthoughts.
bob_constraints: The guide is a conceptual engineering reference, not geometric authority for Ma-2141 or Mallorca.
Do not copy generic slope ratios or dimensions into YACS without site-specific evidence and project acceptance.

source.title: Integrated Approach to Sustainable Roadside Design - Geotechnical

principles: Large elevation changes, cuts and fills can require slope stabilization, drainage or retaining structures.
Retaining-wall need is a geotechnical and structural question rather than a cosmetic mesh-placement decision.
Roadside transitions should be considered in both longitudinal and lateral terrain context.
bob_constraints: Escalate unresolved structural support to review instead of inventing a retaining wall.
Use source evidence to decide whether a structure exists before choosing its representation.

principles: Road geometry review treats horizontal radius, grade, cross slope, superelevation, lane width and shoulder width as separate design criteria.
A plausible road cannot be validated by pavement contact alone.
bob_constraints: Use these categories as inspection questions, not as authority to redesign the canonical YACS route.
YACS physics and canonical route geometry remain outside BOB's authority.

source.title: Landscape Technical Guide in Unreal Engine

principles: Landscape height values use a signed internal range that is multiplied by the Landscape Z scale.
Real-world elevation must be converted deliberately into Unreal height encoding and world units; numeric equality between source metres, height samples and world Z cannot be assumed.
bob_constraints: Before terrain authoring, record Landscape transform and Z scale and prove conversion with sampled world-space heights.
Reject any lesson whose proposed metre-scale correction produces a world-space change outside the recipe bound.

source.title: Coordinate System and Spaces in Unreal Engine

principles: World space is absolute to the level while local space is relative to an actor or scene component and its transform.
Spline APIs can explicitly consume world or local coordinates, while other spline parameters may still be defined in component-local space.
bob_constraints: Record the holder actor transform, spline component transform and Landscape transform before applying a lesson.
Do not mix world-space spline points with local-space assumptions for width, falloff or height reasoning.

principles: Landscape Patches provide another non-destructive procedural mechanism for modifying Landscape height data.
Patch height encoding explicitly distinguishes world-space encoding scale and the meaning of zero height relative to the patch or Landscape.
bob_constraints: Treat Landscape Patches as an alternative experiment when spline semantics are unsuitable; do not switch production backends without a bounded comparison.
Any patch experiment must preserve Base_DTM and use the same before/after footprint guards as spline lessons.
